messages:
Maya: Quick design review: thinking about a left-rail regroup where Models, Datasets, and Embeddings are nested under a single parent label. Working label: 'Library'. Goal: simplify scan, reduce top-level noise. Main blockers: backward-compatible deep links, keyboard users, and breadcrumb semantics.

Jonah: 'Library' reads well in mocks, but in testing some users thought it meant a docs area. If we choose it, we should add a compact subtitle: 'Models, datasets, embeddings'. Also we must keep old routes working (permalinks people have shared in Slack/product issues).

Priya: On permalinks, proposal: support route aliases for 12 months. Server accepts both `/models/:id` and `/library/models/:id` and responds the same. Client router can normalize to canonical `/library/...` with replaceState so back button isn't harmed.

Eli: A11y checklist: 1) ensure skip-to-content anchors land inside the current workspace panel after any client-side rewrite; 2) set `aria-current="page"` on active leaf items; 3) breadcrumbs need role=navigation and a meaningful separator. When a link opens a panel via permalink, programmatically focus the heading and announce a short update in a polite live region.

Keisha: Breadcrumb policy question: should breadcrumbs point to filtered list views (e.g., Workspace > Models (filtered owner:me) > Gen-Model-42) or to the unfiltered list? Users expect the breadcrumb to reflect the UI they came from so I'd prefer filtered state baked into breadcrumb links where applicable. That makes share links reproduce context.

Jonah: Implementation note: avoid encoding complex state directly into the breadcrumb href. Use a short token in the href like `/b/xyz123` that maps to a JSON blob in client storage or a tiny server mapping; otherwise the URL becomes unwieldy. Short tokens preserve readability and keep copy/paste friendly.

Priya: Short tokens require a backend create/read path and TTLs. For fast rollout, we can support query param snapshots (`?s=owner:me,tag:prod`) and add a shortlink service later. We'll document the interim format.

Eli: Keyboard flow: when grouping items under a parent we should keep the parent focusable and allow arrow-key navigation into children (roving tabindex). Also preserve the scroll offset of the left rail when switching between sibling items. Suggest a small client map keyed by cluster id storing scrollTop; restore on focus enter.

Maya: Small router alias example idea (client-side):
```js
const aliases = { '/models': '/library/models', '/datasets': '/library/datasets' }
router.beforeEach((to, from, next) => {
  if (aliases[to.path]) next({ path: aliases[to.path], replace: true })
  else next()
})
```
This keeps the canonical URL visible and avoids extra history entries.

Keisha: UX microcopy: for the parent label we've got 3 options in testing: 'Library' (clear to power users, ambiguous to novices), 'Assets' (too engineering-y for some), 'Data & Models' (explicit but long). My pick: 'Library' with small subtitle and tooltip. Priya will finalize after one more micro-test.

Maya: Risks & rollout: - Permalink compatibility: aliases + 12-month support - Accessibility: add a11y checklist to QA and require screen reader validation for permalink flows - Breadcrumb semantics: include filtered state where it helps, avoid leaking large query strings into anchor text.

Priya: I'll run one small microtest on copy tomorrow and post results. Jonah: can you draft a tiny shortlink feasibility note (infra + auth) and an MVP rollout plan for query-param snapshots vs short tokens?

Jonah: Yep, I'll scope it. Shortlink MVP needs a tiny service + DB + ownership check, estimate 2 sprints. Query-param snapshots are immediate.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: D-9077 "Library regroup: route aliases, breadcrumbs, accessibility" (assignee: Maya). ✅

Maya: Thanks all — I'll attach updated mockup PNGs and a short demo video later. Ping me in thread for quick design sign-off.
